# Captain preferences

<!-- memory tiers: see the stow skill -->

## Editorial rules for this file
- Domain portability: never hardcode fleet domains; refer to "this server's Cloudflare zone", rendered from the chezmoi `fleet.dnsDomain` variable.
- Path portability: use `~` or `$HOME`, never absolute home paths (`/home/<user>`).

## Infrastructure
- Cloudflare tunnels on this server's zone (phillias.cc) are managed CLOUD-SIDE ONLY: ingress changes go through the Zero Trust dashboard (connectors run token-mode/remotely-managed and hot-reload), never by editing server-side cloudflared configs or restarting those daemons. SSH through those tunnels is the critical path for fleet administrative access; a blip or misconfiguration there can sever it. (set 2026-08-22)
- Godoxy/reverse-proxy config changes and restarts: captain handles personally; agents never touch godoxy config without explicit per-task approval. (set 2026-08-25)
- Fallback / model-routing policy: owned by `~/.agents/skills/opencode-config/references/DESIGN.md` (§2.6) — read and update it there; never duplicate its details here. (set 2026-08-27)
- Gate agent + node stack: no-mistakes gate agent is pi (upstream #633). Working `pi` bin is @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.84.2, pinned in mise config.toml (PR #216/217; 0.85.1 and 0.86.0 both reverted 2026-09-20 — three gate runs died with "Stream ended without finish_reason"; no re-bump without a verified full no-mistakes run). Node via mise (`mise use -g node@22`), `~/.local/bin/node` symlinked for the daemon PATH. (set 2026-08-24)
- Gate auth: gate repos use SSH origin via the `~/.ssh/config` `github.com` block first; HTTPS with the `gh auth git-credential` helper only if absolutely necessary. No ssh-agent, no systemd drop-ins, no ephemeral socket paths. pi API keys go in `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` (0600 perms); no plaintext secrets in systemd unit files. (set 2026-08-16)

## Working style
- Prefers free or near-free tooling and is wary of cloud-vendor lock-in; weigh cost before recommending paid or cloud capabilities. (set 2026-08-26)
- Prefer axi skills (gh-axi, chrome-devtools-axi, lavish-axi, quota-axi, chezmoi-axi, mem) over exec-ing out to raw CLIs; they are the agent-ergonomic surface for those tools. (set 2026-08-27)
- Prefer local skill references (e.g. `~/.agents/skills/*/references/`) over web fetching when the material exists locally; check the filesystem first. (set 2026-08-26)
- Automated config sync must run non-interactively: use the wrapper (chezmoi-axi), never a bootstrap, rugged for no-TTY, no user interaction, failing gracefully. (set 2026-08-26)
- Dotfiles changes (REVISED 2026-09-02, post-forensics): disable the chezmoi sync crontab before editing source, then edit → chezmoi re-add → no-mistakes PR to phillias/dotfiles (base master), and re-enable the crontab after the PR ships. The repo's .no-mistakes.yaml zeroes every auto_fix step — findings on dotfiles always escalate: approve, fix by finding ID, or skip individually; never a blanket --action fix. ask-user findings follow the high-blast-radius escalation line below. Merge is the captain gate. After each merge: validate → fast-forward local master → branch cleanup. Canonical source is ~/.local/share/chezmoi only — no separate checkouts. (set 2026-09-02; supersedes the same-day propose-only directive after forensics conclusively exonerated the no-mistakes pipeline — its last activity was 06:17:48, four hours before the 10:43–11:22 wipe; the failure vector was driver-layer authorization, now covered by the escalation lines)
- ask-user findings on high-blast-radius work — repos whose apply target or production surface touches the fleet (dotfiles, mybrain data, infrastructure repos) — always escalate to the captain; never self-decided under ask-user-authority, never blanket-authorized with a single --action fix. (set 2026-09-02, from the 02:51 keys-migration authorization)
- Do not track machine-generated artifacts in dotfiles (no-mistakes daemon unit, bun.lock). (set 2026-08-25)
- Git history surgery on upstream-managed installs (reset --hard etc.): state explicitly what lives inside vs outside the repo and what could be lost before executing — captain wants data-safety guarantees up front. (set 2026-08-25)

- Cheapest-lane dispatch: Firstmate spawn selection runs cost-aware — when multiple lanes qualify for a task, prefer the cheapest qualified lane; policy lives in the provider-catalog skill (`~/.agents/skills/provider-catalog`, `references/PROVIDERS.md`, "Cheapest-qualified-lane dispatch rule"), snapshot rates in that skill's `models.snapshot.json` / `PROVIDERS.md` — never duplicate rate numbers here. (set 2026-09-01)

## Task capture
- Proactively create a backlog task for any non-trivial work — anything requiring more than one step, any investigation, any design decision, or any deliverable worth tracking — using descriptive headline-style titles readable at a glance in the todo pane; mirror backlog items into that pane at every dispatch, completion, decision, and heartbeat (queued→pending, under way→in_progress, blocked→in_progress with the blocker noted, done→completed) and re-seed at session start — the pane is a presentation mirror of `data/backlog.md`, never an authority. (set 2026-08-27)

## Knowledge Portability Directive
- Trigger: any update to `data/learnings.md`, `data/captain.md`, or `data/projects.md`.
- Action: immediately run `axi-memory-add` with the same title and a concise summary of the body.
- Purpose: knowledge searchable and available from every server in the fleet. (set 2026-08-27)

## Provider/chain stack (current as of 2026-09-02; owner: provider-catalog skill)

Prior opencode-go-gw/deepseek-v4-flash direct pin exhausted monthly budget (429 all models, no fallthrough); the 2026-09-14 pr-gate ~274s abort was a dead conditional path on that route (fixed gateway-side). Dynamic route handles failover; large gate prompts (200K+) intermittently trigger upstream "Service temporarily overloaded" — retries through ladder (exercised 2026-09-21: two chezmoi-axi gate runs died, third succeeded). Provider/model composition owned gateway-side per captain preference — never chase route changes through dotfiles PRs. Owner: opencode-config skill references/DESIGN.md §2.8. <!--a:2026-09-21-->
- **pi models.json trap (FIXED #281)**: models must be an ARRAY of ModelDefinition objects; record-form fails silently -> 'Model not found'. Recheck hand-edits against array shape. <!--a:2026-09-13-->

- **Parallel-session hazard (2026-09-12)**: another agent session operating in this home steered the same crew inbox (unexplained 001/008/012 messages) and its sweep later removed task metadata, status files, and the armed PR poll under state/. If fleet records or inbox messages ever appear that this session did not author, treat them as a concurrent operator and reconcile ownership before acting. <!--p:2026-09-20/confirm no concurrent operator is running-->
- **chezmoi sync machinery-drift (resolved 2026-09-19)**: `chezmoi-axi sync --force` used to silently wipe live-only machinery fixes (pi models.json, fallback-chains.json — the 2026-09-15 gate-chain tail incident). Durable fix landed: both files are source-tracked in dotfiles and PR #330 shipped the GLM-first reorder through source, so sync now reconciles machinery from source. If machinery is ever hand-edited live again, snapshot both files before any sync/apply. <!--a:2026-09-20-->
- **no-mistakes custody wedge (2026-09-14, recurred 3x)**: after a mid-run rebase onto newer master, the gate branch ref refs/heads/<branch> stays at the submitted head while the local run head advances content-equivalently; every retry push then rejects non-fast-forward and rerun/sync offer no plan. Arbitration (firstmate-owned): delete the stale gate ref in the gate bare repo (~/.no-mistakes/repos/<repo>.git), worker re-pushes fast-forward from the anchored adopted head (refs/no-mistakes/recover/<run> holds it). Content is never lost. Structural fix belongs upstream no-mistakes. <!--a:2026-09-14-->
